info.title: StudyFlow API
info.description: Courses, assignments and study tracking for students.

post.description: Log in as the shared demo account, rebuilding its data first if it's over an hour old.

Swap the refresh cookie for a new access token (and a new refresh cookie).

The app calls this when it loads, and whenever its 15-minute access token runs out.
End this device's session. Its access token stops working at once, too.
End every session this account has, on every device: for a lost laptop or a leaked token.

patch.description:
Change this deadline and every later one in its series.

A new due_at moves each of them by the same wall-clock change (e.g. "Fridays 23:59" to
"Mondays 09:00"), and "{n}" in a new title is numbered by position in the series.

schema.description: Time zone the due-time change is in

delete.description: Delete this deadline and every later one in its series (the earlier ones stay).

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Study Sessions Get

get.description:
Study time per day and per course for the 7 days starting at `start`.

"Which day" depends on where the student is: 22:00 Monday in Toronto is already Tuesday in
UTC. So the client sends its time zone, and days are computed in that zone. A session counts
on the day it started.

parameters.name: start

schema.description: First day of the week, e.g. a Monday
schema.title: Start

parameters.description: First day of the week, e.g. a Monday

post.description: Turn the feed on, or replace its URL with a new one: the old URL stops working at once.

get.description:
The user's deadlines as iCalendar, for Google, Apple or Outlook calendar to subscribe to.

No login: calendar apps can't send one, so the secret in the URL is the credential. An
unknown, replaced or switched-off token gets a 404, like a feed that never existed.
